deploy-bot: :rotating_light: runtime v3.3.0 rolled out to eu-west canary (10%) — observing increased gen_error rate for model-group 'llama3q-quant-small-batch'. 5xx rose to 2.1% (baseline ~0.1%). Rollback window opens in 30m.
alex chen: saw the spike in prod logs, p95 latency up ~40ms on long-seq requests. Can we pin runtime for that model group immediately?
maria g: +1 to pin. Proposed next step: pin runtime to v3.2.1 for llama3q-quant-small-batch in eu-west and route new requests to the pinned pool.
priya: Agreed. Also note SDK impact: SDK v2.8.0 introduced token-offset hooks that assume runtime hooks present in v3.3.0 — pin avoids intermittent mismatch for enterprise customers using the new SDK.
ben: I'll apply the pin via deploybot. Command I'm going to run: `deploybot pin --target runtime --version 3.2.1 --models "llama3q-quant-small-batch" --region eu-west --until 2024-10-05T06:00Z --reason "canary regression: gen_error/latency"`
alex chen: Ben — add the alert link in the pin reason: https://internal/alerts/ALERT-7921
ben: done :white_check_mark: Pin applied. pin-id=pin-20241005-ll3q. Affected: 28 nodes, 3 availability zones.
sam: QA checklist (I'll run): 1) longseq generation smoke 2) KV cache warmup check 3) end-to-end client integration smoke for SDK v2.8.0. Kicking off smoke tests now.
sam: Quick update — smoke after pin: gen_error down to 0.12% after 5m, latencies trending back to baseline.
maria g: Please update release notes and internal changelog: note "soft-pin" in eu-west for llama3q-quant-small-batch due to latency/regression; include SDK compatibility caveat and rollback steps.
priya: Also draft a short customer-facing blurb for any enterprise tenants in eu-west that might see degraded behavior — we should be proactive.
deploy-bot: Pin status: ACTIVE. pin-id=pin-20241005-ll3q. Rollback scheduled: no. Applied to nodes: 28.
alex chen: Let's keep the pin for 48h while we collect telemetry. If stable, we'll propose an unpin canary at 1% traffic after 48h, then 5% if green.
ben: Runbook/logging snippet I added to the pin: `kubectl get pods -l runtime=3.2.1 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'` and annotated nodes with `pin/llama3q=pin-20241005-ll3q`. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/runtime-pin (internal).
maria g: Thanks — I'll update the runbook, release notes, and set a calendar reminder for the 48h unpin review. :calendar: 
priya: tagging @oncall-ops for visibility and follow-up during the nightshift.
alex chen: Closing the thread for now — monitoring dashboards and will reopen if error rate or latency creeps. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
